summary: Frontend-only verification of the EN/ES i18n toggle (react-i18next) on the public preview URL. RESULT: The reported bug is NOT reproducible — the toggle works correctly. Clicking [data-testid=lang-es] on /login instantly switches the UI to Spanish, persists to localStorage('ty_lang'='es'), survives reload, and applies across Register, Marketing nav, app bottom-nav and Memberships plan names. No i18n/i18next console errors or warnings. Remaining findings are translation COVERAGE gaps (untranslated strings), not a toggle defect.

diagnostics_window_i18n.console_errors_or_warnings_mentioning_i1: NONE. Only React DevTools info messages were logged; no pageerror events.

action_items: No fix needed for the toggle — it functions correctly on the deployed preview build. The main agent's manual failure was almost certainly an environment/caching artifact (note: a service worker is registered in src/index.js, which can serve a stale bundle in manual/screenshot harness checks — consider bumping the SW cache version or skipping precache of the JS bundle in dev).

OPTIONAL (coverage): extend translation keys to the Home dashboard, Marketing hero/body sections, and Memberships page chrome ('Choose {plan}', MONTHLY/YEARLY, per-period suffix, MOST POPULAR, 7-DAY FREE TRIAL) — currently they stay English while nested plan data is Spanish, producing mixed-language strings like 'Choose Esencial'.
Remove the temporary window.__i18n debug hook before shipping.
critical_code_review_comments: i18n config is sound: keySeparator/nsSeparator=false correctly supports flat literal keys such as 'i18n:memb.plan.essential.name'; no raw 'i18n:' key leakage observed on Memberships.
LanguageDetector order is ['localStorage'] only — a first-time Spanish-browser user will still get English. Consider adding 'navigator' to the detection order if auto-detect is desired.
Service worker registration (src/index.js) has no versioned cache-busting; stale bundles are a real risk for verifying new features.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested i18n toggle/persistence/coverage checks passed

Only untranslated-copy coverage gaps remain (Home dashboard, Marketing hero, Memberships chrome). No console errors. If a future check appears to fail, suspect the registered service worker serving a cached bundle rather than i18n config.
rca_of_the_issue: Not a code defect. Playwright with full DOM control shows i18n.changeLanguage('es') fires on click, updates language/resolvedLanguage to 'es', re-renders all subscribed components, and writes ty_lang=es to localStorage. The main agent's inability to observe the switch stems from its screenshot harness not executing post-load clicks / re-render capture, compounded by a registered service worker that can serve a stale JS bundle.
